headline: Binance says it has now replaced about 90% of the stolen crypto, with withdrawals still due to restart on Sunday and the full reserve proof now expected around Tuesday.

market.asOf: BTC, ETH and SOL from CoinGecko coin pages read at about 15:57-15:59 UTC Sat 31 Oct (22:57-22:59 Bangkok). CoinGecko's own BTC page showed conflicting 24h figures, so no BTC change is shown. Check the live prices at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: CoinGecko's sentiment gauge showed 40 ('Fear') at about 15:56 UTC. alternative.me's Fear and Greed Index could not be read this run.

stories.title: Binance says 90% of stolen crypto is replaced; withdrawals still set for Sunday
stories.summary: Binance says it has now replaced about 90% of the assets taken in the hack, up from about 80% earlier. Withdrawals are still paused and are due to restart on Sunday 1 Nov, but Binance has not given an exact hour. The full Proof of Reserves (a public check that customer balances are fully backed) is now expected around Tuesday 3 Nov.
points: Binance says it has replenished about 90% of the stolen assets and set aside more than $6.34B, including $5B it already held in the affected tokens, per CoinDesk.

Ten tokens are fully covered: BTC, ETH, USDT, BNB, SOL, USDC, XRP, USD1, RLUSD and ZEC. The rest, mostly smaller altcoins, is still being bought on the market and in private (OTC) deals, per TechFlow.
Withdrawals are still targeted for Sun 1 Nov with details to come through official channels; no source this edition gives an exact time, per CoinDesk and TechFlow.
A reserve snapshot was taken at 00:00 UTC on 31 Oct; building the full zero-knowledge proof takes about 40-50 hours, so it should land around 3 Nov, per ChainCatcher and TokenPost.
Binance co-CEO Richard Teng said investigators found more ways in than the employee laptop first suspected, per CoinDesk.

stories.title: Stolen bitcoin still parked as October ends with big ETF outflows
stories.summary: Trackers give slightly different totals for how much was stolen and frozen, so each is named. The 18,270 stolen bitcoin has not moved, while US spot bitcoin and ether funds lost money on Friday. Bitcoin's monthly candle closes at 00:00 UTC on Sunday (07:00 Bangkok).
points: Amount stolen: Elliptic says $6.43B, TRM Labs $6.36B and Binance about $6.3B.
Frozen: Binance and partners about $3B (CoinDesk); Elliptic $2.85B; TRM about $2.7B as of 30 Oct. Elliptic says about $3.21B is in assets issuers cannot freeze.
The 18,270 stolen BTC sits in 19 addresses and none had been spent as of 2:02am ET Friday, per CoinDesk; Elliptic says none of it has been frozen.
US spot bitcoin ETFs had net outflows of $643.2M on 30 Oct, the largest since June, and spot ether ETFs $155.7M, per crypto.news.
October losses depend on the starting price: CoinGlass (via Cointelegraph) had bitcoin on track for -7.7%, its worst October since 2014; Coinpedia puts it at -11.37%.

stories.title: The hack becomes an election-week fight in Washington
stories.summary: With the US midterm elections on Tuesday 3 Nov, officials and lawmakers are using the Binance hack to argue over the stalled crypto market-structure bill (the CLARITY Act).
points: President Trump said he was looking into the hack and that Binance says customers will be repaid, per The Block.
Senator Cynthia Lummis said the CLARITY Act's freeze tools would have helped: 'Every minute lost is money gone for good,' per The Block.
CFTC Chair Mike Selig said 'These are unregulated offshore exchanges,' per The Block.
The CLARITY Act passed the House but has stalled in the Senate, per The Block.

briefs.title: Coinbase Q3: revenue down, profit up
briefs.summary: Revenue was $1.22B, down 35% from a year earlier; net income was $719M, including a $715M gain on crypto it holds, per The Block.

briefs.title: Trezor warns of a possible tampered device
briefs.summary: Trezor says anyone who bought a device from reseller CryptoBilis since March 2026 should move their funds now, after a report of a cellular implant in a Safe 5, per The Block.

briefs.title: Strategy changes its preferred-stock dividends
briefs.summary: Holders approved dividends that accrue daily, starting 1 Nov for STRC, and MSTR fell 8.7% on Friday morning, per The Block.

briefs.title: Hack knocked about $100B off the crypto market
briefs.summary: Total crypto market value fell from nearly $2.7T to below $2.6T by midday Friday, per Yahoo Finance.

briefs.title: Big bitcoin options expiry next Friday
briefs.summary: About $2.065B of bitcoin options expire on Fri 6 Nov, with a put/call ratio of 0.32, per TokenPost.
